title: Archer pawn: why Spiral Arrow and Heavenly Shot abort
intro: Take over the second Archer pawn (the Archer) and stand near an enemy. Then press End (or click both sticks) to start.

steps.text: AS IT IS NOW: aim once with R1 and let go. Then try Spiral Arrow and Heavenly Shot a few times each.
Next: the mod's bow aim camera is switched off for this session (not saved). Press End when ready.
AIM CAMERA OFF: aim once with R1 and let go. Then try Spiral Arrow and Heavenly Shot again, same way.
Done. The aim camera is back on. Tell Claude what you saw.

probes.up: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local ch=d and d.state and d.state.pawn_chara; if not ch then return '-' end; local fsm=ch:call('get_ActionManager'):get_field('Fsm'); return tostring(fsm:call('getCurrentNodeName(System.UInt32)',1)):gsub('^Combat%.',''):gsub('Job02_SkillAttack%.','')
probes.hold: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; return d and d.R and d.R.aim_hold and true or false
probes.skill: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local ch=d and d.state and d.state.pawn_chara; return ch and ch:call('get_Human'):call('get_CustomSkillState') or 0
probes.shot: local d=_G.DPC_dbg; local ch=d and d.state and d.state.pawn_chara; if not ch then return false end; local n=tostring(ch:call('get_ActionManager'):get_field('Fsm'):call('getCurrentNodeName(System.UInt32)',1)); return n:find('Shoot',1,true)~=nil or n:find('Release',1,true)~=nil
